notes.title: New Release - Fortix 2
notes.content:
Fortix 2 is now available on Steam and is 10% off until May 13th at 10AM Pacific Time!

Help Sir Fortix conquer more castles and the evil minions who dwell there in this sequel to the hit indie puzzle game. Includes 25 Steam Achievements!

notes.title: Fortix Update Released
notes.content:
Updates to Fortix have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:
  • Added Russian localization
  • Added Hungarian localization
  • Updated keyboard control (the player can now use WASD keys to control the knight)
  • Updated "Leaderboard" menu to sort scores by friends
  • Added a Retry button to "Game Paused" window

notes.title: Fortix Released on Steam
notes.content: Featuring Steam Leaderboards and Achievements, Fortix is a a new type of strategy and arcade game. Can you emerge victorious and reclaim the land of your ancestors? You are knight Fortix, the sole hope for the desolate and tortured land of Fortiana to become the fertile land that it was before.
